what: a machine with no agent running and nothing ever said in any conversation -- the scene every stand run has actually met
why: Point GRIPTERM_AGENT_RECORDING at this file and a window answers the three observation questions from here instead of spawning `claude` three times. It is what the measurement of Ш4б was taken through: `claude agents --json` costs 702-5353 ms on an unchanged tree, which is three to ten times any repair worth making, so nothing about the cost of a start could be shown until the spawns were gone.
faithful: Not an idealisation. A stand run types nothing into its terminals, so its conversations leave no transcript and its `claude` processes die with the sitting -- an empty roster and an empty index is what the real ports answer there, at a cost of several seconds.
agent: a recording of a quiet machine
